runs.title: Q3 2025 Hiring Funnel Report
runs.body:
Q3 2025 Hiring Funnel Report

The hiring funnel in Q3 2025 moved from 1,450 applications to 230 interviews, 48 offers, and 35 hires. Overall, the funnel produced 35 hires from 1,450 applications, indicating a significant narrowing from top to bottom.

The largest drop-off occurred between applications and interviews: the pipeline decreased by 1,220 candidates at that stage. This is the most material contraction in the quarter and the clearest driver of overall conversion. By comparison, the drop from interviews to offers was 182, and the drop from offers to hires was 13, which is an offer-to-hire conversion rate of 72.9%.

From a leadership perspective, the data suggests the main leverage point is earlier in the process, where the greatest volume is lost. The later stages converted more efficiently, but the sharp reduction between applications and interviews limited the size of the downstream pipeline. For planning purposes, the quarter closed with 35 hires, which should be considered alongside the relatively large top-of-funnel volume of 1,450 applications.

judge_scores.justification: The report faithfully uses the table data, clearly highlights the largest drop-off, and adds the requested offer-to-hire conversion rate, with only minor redundancy in repeating the same funnel narrative.

runs.title: Q3 2025 Hiring Funnel Report
runs.body:
Q3 2025 Hiring Funnel Report

This quarter, the hiring funnel moved from 1,450 applications to 35 hires, a 2.4% application-to-hire conversion rate.

The largest drop-off occurred between applications and interviews. Of 1,450 applications, 230 reached interview, a decline of 1,220 and a 15.9% application-to-interview conversion rate. This was the sharpest constraint in the funnel.

Attrition continued in the later stages, though at a smaller scale. The funnel moved from 230 interviews to 48 offers, then from 48 offers to 35 hires. Thirteen offered candidates did not convert to hires. The offer-to-hire conversion rate was 72.9%.

The main opportunity is at the top of the funnel, where most candidates do not progress into interviews. Later stages are tighter, but there is still room to improve offer acceptance and final conversion.
